response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS average_amount FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency), compared AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, average_amount, average_amount / NULLIF(AVG(average_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency), 0) AS ratio FROM account_averages) SELECT account_id, frequency, average_amount, ratio FROM compared ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
